description: This file defines the ListPartDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of ListPart content parts within OrchardCore CMS. It includes methods for rendering various display shapes and admin interfaces, handling content type definitions, and querying contained items.

classes.name: ListPartDisplayDriver
classes.description: A driver class responsible for rendering and editing ListPart content parts, including admin interfaces and display shapes within OrchardCore.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Returns the editor interface for a ListPart, combining navigation and header admin shapes.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Returns the display shapes for a ListPart, including various admin and detail views.

methods.name: InitializeEditListPartHeaderAdmin
methods.description: Creates the admin shape for editing the ListPart header.

methods.name: InitializeEditListPartNavigationAdmin
methods.description: Creates the admin shape for editing the ListPart navigation.

methods.name: InitializeDisplayListPartSummaryAdmin
methods.description: Creates the summary admin shape for the ListPart.

methods.name: InitializeDisplayListPartHeaderAdminShape
methods.description: Creates the display admin shape for the ListPart header.

methods.name: InitializeDisplayListPartNavigationAdminShape
methods.description: Creates the display admin shape for the ListPart navigation.

methods.name: InitializeDisplayListPartDetailAdminShape
methods.description: Creates the admin shape for detailed ListPart display, including content items and filtering.

methods.name: InitializeDisplayListPartDetailAdminSearchPanelShape
methods.description: Creates the search panel shape for ListPart admin detail view.

methods.name: InitializeDisplayListPartDisplayShape
methods.description: Creates the display shape for the ListPart, showing contained items.

methods.name: GetPagerSlimAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a PagerSlim object for pagination based on the display context.

methods.name: GetContainedContentTypesAsync
methods.description: Fetches content type definitions for contained items based on ListPart settings.
